messages:
marie: Starting a follow-up thread for last night's weird cross-region churn that led to TLS handshake retry spikes and short LB ejections. Need owners for short/long-term fixes and clear ETAs.

troy: I pulled route-sync and lb logs. We saw a cluster of rapid rule patches from controller around 2026-12-02T04:18:xx causing ~110 pushes in 2m. Snippet: ```
2026-12-02T04:18:12Z route-sync WARN apply: timeout after 3s (attempt=2)
2026-12-02T04:18:13Z lb-proxy WARN backend: handshake timeout, initiating retry
```

rachel: Short-term mitigation idea: add a lightweight debounce at the proxy to collapse identical consecutive edits for 12s and emit proxy.debounce.suppressed_count. I can own the debounce + metric and a staging canary. ETA 2026-12-10.

gabe: I'll take LB retry policy changes. Short-term: cap inter-region TLS retries to 2 and add jitter 75-300ms. Long-term: make retry policy configurable per cluster. ETA canary 2026-12-08.

lynn: Noting recurrence: I found similar small incidents in 2026-07 and 2026-09 around large config rolls. I'll correlate deploy timestamps and controller events and add to the postmortem doc. Due 2026-12-06.

marie: Assigning owners: rachel -> proxy debounce+metric+alert (due 12/10), gabe -> LB retry cap+jitter+canary (due 12/08), lynn -> deploy correlation & postmortem notes (due 12/06).

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-2620 "proxy debounce + LB retry cap/jitter" https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2620 (assigned rachel,gabe)

rachel: Quick note: alert proposal: proxy.debounce.suppressed_count > 50 for 10m -> P2, and staging threshold: >200 for 10m. Will add dashboard panel per-cluster.

gabe: Canary applied to eu-west-2 2026-12-07T01:20Z. Early telemetry: handshake retry rate down from 1.9% -> 0.18% over 4h.

rachel: Deployed debounce to staging 2026-12-06T09:40Z. Smoke run with simulated churn (see repro) -> suppressed_count=74 and handshake retries dropped ~82%.

lynn: Reproducer added to postmortem doc: run this against staging to simulate flaps: ```
for i in $(seq 1 80); do kubectl apply -f route.yaml; sleep 0.25; done
watch -n 2 "curl -sS https://api.redwood/healthz -w '\n%{http_code} %{time_starttransfer}\n' -o /dev/null"
```

marie: Two open long-term items: 1) research ticket for controller reconciliation storms (probable cache invalidation race), 2) add monthly chaos/regression that includes inter-region jitter tests. Volunteers?

lynn: I'll file the controller research ticket and gather traces (due 2027-01-05).

rachel: I'll add the monthly regression to the oncall runbook and add a checklist for canary verification.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly check-in for INF-2620 scheduled 2026-12-09T16:00Z. Invitees: rachel,gabe,lynn,marie.

marie: Closing note: once INF-2620 shows stable prod metrics for 72h and postmortem actions are complete I'll close this thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
